about: The most-seen species' own acts (lane SIG5, 2026-11-24; decision 424: every species does its own signature behaviour, most-seen first), on clips their live v3 rigs have (src/ark-scene/recipe-templates-domestic.ts). Applied to src/ark-scene/recipes.json by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts. A line is given only where the species' own stored text states the behaviour (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json), with its sentence; the others are drawn without a log line. Strips: ~/AnimalDex-work/sig5/t1-after and t1-before.
